newsitem.title: IRAN: WRESTLING-TEHRAN SAYS U.S. WRESTLERS TO ATTEND MEET IN IRAN.
newsitem.headline: WRESTLING-TEHRAN SAYS U.S. WRESTLERS TO ATTEND MEET IN IRAN.

text.p: A U.S. wrestling club team has applied to attend an international wrestling tournament in Iran later this year, state-run Tehran radio said on Tuesday.

It said the U.S. wrestlers, who have refused to compete in Iran in recent years, would attend the tournament in freestyle and Greco-Roman wrestling along with athletes from at least nine other countries.

Iran, which attended the 1996 Atlanta Olympics and several earlier sporting events in the United States, has repeatedly criticised a U.S. refusal to send teams to three recent world wrestling events in the Islamic republic.

Tehran said in December it would not send its freestyle wrestling team, which includes several medal contenders, to a world championship due to be held in the United States in April to protest against the U.S. refusal.
